renMemoryRecords.text: That carp is perfect, Ren! I'll simmer it with pondside herbs tonight. Thanks for the quick delivery!
Glad it suits the pot, Sora. The pond was calm this morning—carp were rising near the reeds. Enjoy your supper.
I'm glad you liked the carp! Let me know if you're up for talking about the pond and some local cooking sometime. Until then!
I'd like that, Sora. The reeds by the pond are thick this year—good spot to talk herbs and carp. Find me there most mornings.
